_comment: Offline advisory snapshot for the guardian-fixture demo (OSV schema). IDs, packages, ranges and CVSS vectors follow the public OSV/GHSA records; summaries are shortened. Live OSV is authoritative: use this only for air-gapped demos and tests.

vulns.details:
minimist's argument parser can be tricked into modifying `Object.prototype` through crafted argument names such as `--__proto__.x` or constructor/prototype keys, which can lead to prototype pollution in the calling program.

### Workarounds
Do not pass untrusted input to `minimist()`; validate argument names before parsing.
Crafted arguments using `constructor` or `__proto__` keys let minimist add or modify properties of `Object.prototype`.

vulns.summary: Flask vulnerable to possible disclosure of permanent session cookie due to missing Vary: Cookie header
vulns.details:
When all of these hold, a caching proxy may cache a response carrying one client's session cookie and send it to other clients: the app runs behind a caching proxy that does not strip cookies or ignore responses with cookies; the app sets `session.permanent = True`; the app does not access or modify the session during the request; `SESSION_REFRESH_EACH_REQUEST` is enabled (the default); the app does not set a `Cache-Control` header marking the page private.

### Workarounds
Set `Cache-Control: private` (or `Vary: Cookie`) on responses that use the session, or configure the proxy not to cache responses that set cookies.

vulns.summary: Unintended leak of Proxy-Authorization header in requests
vulns.details: When a request is redirected to an HTTPS endpoint through a proxy, requests can forward the `Proxy-Authorization` header to the destination server, leaking proxy credentials.

vulns.summary: Requests Session object does not verify requests after making first request with verify=False
vulns.details: If the first request in a `Session` is made with `verify=False`, later requests to the same host keep skipping certificate verification even when `verify` is changed.
